thread:
anna: rolling APAC 15% now — small staged rollout rr_2891_apac15. monitoring p95, 5xx, and cache metrics. change window open.

deploy-bot: rollout initiated -> id=rr_2891_apac15, target=15% 

luis: cheers. I'll keep an eye on synth checks and user-facing errors.

ops-sre: 90s telemetry: p95 310ms, errors 0/40. baseline.

deploy-bot: 180s update -> 4/40 errors (10.0%), majority 502 from apac-edge-2. autoscaler triggered +1 node.

luis: seeing 502s too. stack traces show upstream timeouts hitting inference-proxy at 120s. Not sure if model change increased cold-starts.

platform-lead: traffic steering note — a subset of customers are still routed via legacy apac-cache for ~8s; that could magnify spikes.

anna: let's hold if errors keep rising. can we divert affected shard traffic back to eu fallback while we root-cause?

deploy-bot: 300s update -> 9/40 errors (22.5%). staging: request latency tail rising to p95=720ms. Status: DEGRADING.

release-manager: change window still open. I authorize a temporary traffic diversion + pin to last stable until we diagnose. Please capture a telemetry snapshot and brief release note.

anna: executing diversion -> `redwoodctl routes divert --from apac-edge --to eu-edge --filter shard=apac-2`

anna: pinning route to v2.12-stable as precaution:
```
redwoodctl routes pin --route default --version v2.12-stable --reason "apac 502 spike"
```

ops-sre: diversion in place, sample shows errors falling on diverted sessions. Running a 20-call canary against v2.12-stable on apac-2: 0/20 errors, p95=330ms.

deploy-bot: rollout rr_2891_apac15 PAUSED by anna; pin recorded -> pin_id=pin_289101. Telemetry snapshot saved -> /telemetry/rollouts/rr_2891_apac15/snap_2891012345.log

luis: adding a short release note to the changelog: "APAC 15% rollout paused and routes pinned to v2.12-stable after transient 502s on apac-edge-2. Traffic diverted to EU edge for affected shard during investigation."

platform-lead: I'll schedule infra-led repro on apac-edge-2 with kv-cache team and coordinate with ml-research on any hot-start behavior changes. tagging @ops-sre and @ml-research.

anna: thanks all. we'll keep the pin until postmortem. if ops-sre confirms infra-only root cause, we can re-run a constrained canary after fixes.

release-manager: filing postmortem ticket and assigning follow-ups. Good call to divert and pin quickly. :+1:
